NoteDocument model landed with AttributedString and markdown bridges, 22 tests. Review found and fixed three round-trip bugs (markdown escaping, paragraph joining, separator over-trim). The ScratchpadPad.text String->NoteDocument swap folds into ccp-2zi.4, where the UserDefaults storage is removed anyway.

NoteEditor landed on SwiftUI's AttributedString TextEditor: styled blocks, list markers, inline mark commands with shortcuts, return-splits-block. Review found two real defects (attribute-based marker stripping dropped typed text; structural edits never redrew) — both fixed by counting markers and redrawing on structure change, with caret preservation. 210 tests green. Block kind commands split out to their own bead.

Block kinds are reachable three ways: markdown-style autoformatting on the line being typed, a block-kind menu that works from a caret alone, and indent/outdent with cmd-[ and cmd-]. Indent is now drawn (counted spaces, like the markers) so it can be seen as well as set. Review found two real defects, both fixed: autoformatting scanned the whole note and could convert an unrelated paragraph and drag the caret to it (now scoped to the caret's block), and reading the indent and the glyph as one marker stranded a bullet in the user's text when a space in front of it went missing (now shed separately, so backspace in the indent outdents and backspace in the glyph demotes). 236 tests.

Plan written from the real docs and filed as the bead's design. Two findings reshaped the epic: only a space-scoped connection can create documents (so CCP requires one), and PUT /blocks updates in place taking markdown, so a push is a block diff rather than the delete-and-repost the epic feared — and the markdown bridge from ccp-2zi.1 is already the mapping. Settled: unknown Craft blocks are preserved and never touched via a store-side sidecar of CCP-owned ids; conflicts append a dated 'Conflicted copy' to the Craft document so nothing loses; the editor stays disabled until the note has actually loaded, since with no local truth an empty pad over a failed read is what destroys a note. .5 and .6 rewritten, ccp-jmk filed to confirm the auth scheme against a live connection (blocks .3). Two things still need the user: creating that connection, and whether the pad may stop sharing a note with upstream's floating pad after migration.

Adopt swift-markdown-engine, markdown becomes the pad's truth — the survey is on this bead's design field, the adoption is ccp-dn5 with a working spike on branch spike/markdown-engine.
